exception: java.lang.IllegalStateException: No connectivity resource package found
mechanism: apexd fails decompression of .capex onto tmpfs /data (FS_IOC_GETFLAGS ioctl fails ENOTTY). Consequently com.android.tethering is not mounted or activated, PackageManagerService never scans its priv-app directory, and ServiceConnectivityResources.apk is not indexed.
class_fix: Replace all 15 .capex files in /system/apex with authentic uncompressed original_apex (.apex), eliminating decompression on tmpfs /data completely.
